tvShow.name: Dr. STONE
tvShow.overview: One fateful day, all of humanity was petrified by a blinding flash of light. After several millennia, high schooler Taiju awakens and finds himself lost in a world of statues. However, he’s not alone! His science-loving friend Senku’s been up and running for a few months and he's got a grand plan in mind—to kickstart civilization with the power of science!

episodes.name: Behind the Scenes of Dr. STONE
episodes.overview: Crunchyroll takes you behind the scenes of this season’s biggest show, Dr. STONE. Meet the Producer, Shusuke Katagiri, and Director, Shinya Iino, as they take us through the process of creating a hit anime. From storyboards to screens, see the making of an episode of Dr. STONE.

episodes.name: Dr. STONE Special Feature
episodes.overview: A recap episode with additional scenes which was released on Jump's official YouTube channel for Jump Special Anime Festa 2020.

episodes.name: Ryusui
episodes.overview: Senku's team searches for oil, but their new captain, Ryusui, poses unexpected challenges.

episodes.name: Stone World
episodes.overview: Several thousand years after a mysterious phenomenon  turns all of humanity to stone, the extraordinarily intelligent, science-driven boy, Senku Ishigami, awakens from petrification. Facing a world of stone and the total collapse of civilization, Senku makes up his mind to use science to rebuild the world. Starting with his super strong childhood friend Taiju Oki, who awakened at the same time, they will begin to rebuild civilization from nothing. Depicting two million years of scientific history from the Stone Age to present day, the unprecedented crafting adventure story is about to begin.

episodes.name: King of the Stone World
episodes.overview: Facing immediate danger from wild animals Senku and Taiju are forced to revive Tsukasa Shishio "The Strongest High School Primate". Although Tsukasa has tremendous fighting ability and provides abundant food as their hunter, their new ally harbors an opposing view on restoring humanity.

episodes.name: Weapons of Science
episodes.overview: Senku does not trust the motivation of Shishio, so he will try to hide his plans from a new and unforeseen enemy for his plan to revive civilization.

episodes.name: Fire the Smoke Signal
episodes.overview: Senku has the idea of ​​creating gunpowder to have a way to balance the scale and have a chance to defeat Shishio. The production of gunpowder causes a fire. Shortly thereafter, Senku and the others discover smoke signals on the horizon. An accident? Hardly likely. Apparently there are other people in the stone world ...

episodes.name: Stone World The Beginning
episodes.overview: Shishio is determined to end Senku's life if he does not promise at that moment that he will abandon his idea of ​​recovering civilization as it was before the incident.

episodes.name: Two Nations of the Stone World
episodes.overview: Taiju and Yuzuriha figure out Senku's secret to reviving him. But now that he's back, they need to deal with Tsukasa.

episodes.name: Where Two Million Years Have Gone
episodes.overview: Kohaku shows Senku to her village, but it's going to take some convincing before they let him in. In the meantime, he makes friends with a like-minded, promising "sorcerer."

episodes.name: Stone Road
episodes.overview: Kohaku's sister, village priestess Ruri, is gravely ill. Senku, Chrome and Kohaku begin their quest to make antibiotics to save her life.

episodes.name: Let There Be the Light of Science
episodes.overview: Senku starts a ramen stand in hopes of winning over support for his kingdom of science, but some people are too principled to take such a bribe. Mentalist Asagiri Gen is not one of them.

episodes.name: A Flimsy Alliance
episodes.overview: Senku and his kingdom of science successfully test the first lightbulb since the collapse. Meanwhile, Asagiri Gen, a spy from Tsukasa's empire, is killed by an unknown attacker.

episodes.name: Clear World
episodes.overview: The development of glassworks, an important step for making sulfa drugs and for chemistry as a whole, turns out to have a surprising benefit for Suika.

episodes.name: Buddies Back to Back
episodes.overview: To make antibiotics, Senku and his kingdom need to obtain sulfuric acid from a fountain of the stuff. The team goes prepared, but there's no guarantee that they'll make it back alive.

episodes.name: Masked Warrior
episodes.overview: All that's needed to make antibiotics is alcohol. The best way to get some is to win the Grand Bout, which the Senku and his kingdom will also need to do in order to keep Magma away from Ruri and give her the drug.

episodes.name: Master of Flame
episodes.overview: After Magma's series of tricks to reach the final match, Chrome reveals a trick of his own! With a little extra help from Gen, Chrome just may be able to pull this one off!

episodes.name: The Culmination of Two Million Years
episodes.overview: After Senku's unlikely victory, quick marriage, and even hastier divorce, the kingdom of science is back to work to finally finish Ruri's medicine!

episodes.name: A Tale for the Ages
episodes.overview: Ruri reveals the origin of the village's name and Senku learns of his father's fate!

episodes.name: A Hundred Nights and a Thousand Skies
episodes.overview: Byakuya and the astronauts' story continues, and Senku's connection to Ishigami Village and the Hundred Tales is finally revealed.

episodes.name: Stone Wars
episodes.overview: Tsukasa's army is coming! Kinro struggles to hold the bridge against the deadly spearman Hyoga and his shock troops, but Senku and the villagers are ready with deadly new weapons of science!

episodes.name: To Modernity
episodes.overview: Hyoga is disarmed, but the kingdom of science is still in danger - Ishigami village is in flames! And Tsukasa will soon know that Senku is still alive... How will the villagers fight off the coming invasion?

episodes.name: The Age of Energy
episodes.overview: Work begins on creating the components for Senku's cell phone, but spinning gold wire is proving to be quite the task! Luckily, Chrome and Kaseki "invent" the water wheel and drastically improve the process!

episodes.name: Spartan Crafts Club
episodes.overview: With Chrome and Kaseki’s water wheel finished, Ishigami Village moves into the age of electricity! But with the primitive materials available to him, will Senku be able to create a filament that can withstand the intense heat of operating a vacuum tube?

episodes.name: The Treasure
episodes.overview: Senku, Chrome, and Magma venture into a cave in search of Tungsten, but there's a suspicious accident that leaves Senku and Chrome trapped at the bottom of a pit! What is Magma up to?!

episodes.name: Wave of Science
episodes.overview: Senku and the rest of the village get to work on making the components for the cell phone. It's hard work but everyone is pumped!

episodes.name: Voices Over Infinite Distance
episodes.overview: After a successful test of their new cell phone, Senku learns of a mysterious tale about a bee named Speaker who can play the voices of the dead.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview:
After five years of harboring unspoken feelings, Taiju Ooki is finally ready to confess his love to Yuzuriha Ogawa. Just when Taiju begins his confession however, a blinding green light strikes the Earth and petrifies mankind around the world—turning every single human into stone.

Several millennia later, Taiju awakens to find the modern world completely nonexistent, as nature has flourished in the years humanity stood still. Among a stone world of statues, Taiju encounters one other living human: his science-loving friend Senkuu, who has been active for a few months. Taiju learns that Senkuu has developed a grand scheme—to launch the complete revival of civilization with science. Taiju's brawn and Senkuu's brains combine to forge a formidable partnership, and they soon uncover a method to revive those petrified.

However, Senkuu's master plan is threatened when his ideologies are challenged by those who awaken. All the while, the reason for mankind's petrification remains unknown.

episodes.name: Stone Wars Beginning
episodes.overview: Senku continues in trying to advance the Stone World, this time he makes "space food", it is in actuality cup noodles. After Senku finishes his project, Gen has an epiphany and devises a plan to take down Tsukasa's army without violence.

episodes.name: Hot Line
episodes.overview: While Senku's diversion buys Gen and others some time, soon Homura realizes something is not right.

episodes.name: Call from the Dead
episodes.overview: Taiju and Yuzuriha are on the verge of tears after they hear Senku's voice, and Senku informs them of his plan to win the war without any bloodshed.

episodes.name: Full Assault
episodes.overview: Chrome and Magma struggle with Ukyo, while Senku, gets his hands busy with building up an invention; a new hope.

episodes.name: Steam Gorilla
episodes.overview: The final touches to the automobile are made and it is used to transport the science supplies to a fortified cliffside that's close to the Tsukasa empire. From there the automobile is upgraded into a tank, but unbeknownst to the rescue group preparations by the empire have been made to counter any vehicular attack.

episodes.name: Prison Break
episodes.overview: Chrome must use all of his scientific knowledge to escape from his prison and save Senku and others.

episodes.name: Secret Mission
episodes.overview: Senku decides to use the Steam-Gorilla to capture The Miracle Cave. Using Lillian's recording, Senku gains the trust of more of Tsukasa's men. Ukyo reveals he saw Yuzuriha's secret mission to reassemble the fragments of statues Tsukasa destroyed.

episodes.name: Final Battle
episodes.overview: The Final Battle for the miracle cave starts as Senku and the Kingdom of Science conduct a frontal assault on the cave.

episodes.name: To Destroy and to Save
episodes.overview: Tsukasa and Hyoga are coming to capture the miracle cave. The Kingdom of Science must buy Senku and Chrome some time to turn the tide, or it is all over.

episodes.name: Humanity's Strongest Tag Team
episodes.overview: Senku demands a truce from Tsukasa in return for reviving his sister, Mirai, who Tsukasa comes to know is alive, but a new problem shows up when Hyoga shows his true self.

episodes.name: PROLOGUE OF Dr. STONE
episodes.overview: The Kingdom of Science is victorious, however it is not over for Senku. Senku must use all of his knowledge to cure Tsukasa who is severly injured.

seasons.name: Stone Wars
seasons.overview:
Senkuu has made it his goal to bring back two million years of human achievement and revive the entirety of those turned to statues. However, one man stands in his way: Tsukasa Shishiou, who believes that only the fittest of those petrified should be revived.

As spring approaches, Senkuu and his allies in Ishigami Village finish the preparations for their attack on the Tsukasa Empire. With a reinvented cell phone model now at their disposal, the Kingdom of Science is ready to launch its newest scheme to recruit the sizable numbers of Tsukasa's army to their side. However, it is a race against time; for every day the Kingdom of Science spends perfecting their inventions, the empire rapidly grows in number.

Reuniting with old friends and gaining new allies, Senkuu and the Kingdom of Science must stop Tsukasa's forces in order to fulfill their goal of restoring humanity and all its creations. With the two sides each in pursuit of their ideal world, the Stone Wars have now begun!

episodes.name: NEW WORLD MAP
episodes.overview: While continuing to use the hot air balloon to search for the oil, it's decided that Ishigami Village needs to take up agriculture to prevent future food shortages, as well as to produce preserved food for their upcoming sea voyage.

episodes.name: Greed Equals Justice
episodes.overview: The Kingdom of Science will need rations to last them through their voyage to the other side of the world. But Senku, being no professional, burns all the bread he attempts to bake.

episodes.name: First Contact
episodes.overview: Senku, brings along a team to look for the Sagara Oil Fields. Meanwhile, Suika and Francois go truffle hunting.

crew.name: Kitipong Udompituk
crew.original_name: กิตติพงษ์ อุดมพิทักษ์

crew.name: Manop Jangsataen
crew.original_name: มานพ แจ้งสะเด็น

episodes.name: Eyes of Science
episodes.overview: The morse code signal reading "WHY" saturates the airwaves too much for Ukyo to pinpoint a direction, so the Kingdom of Science works on a way to visualize the signal.

episodes.name: Science Vessel Perseus
episodes.overview: Kaseki's efforts to build the science vessel Perseus hit a roadblock when he realizes that it's impossible to get all the parts to fit in practice.

episodes.name: TREASURE BOX
episodes.overview: The Perseus crew are on their way to the treasure island, the birthplace of the Hundred Tales, where they hope to locate the treasure box left behind by the Soyuz crew.

episodes.name: Ray of Despair, Ray of Hope
episodes.overview: The Perseus arrives at the treasure island. A recon squad consisting of Senku, Soyuz, Kohaku, and Gen set off to locate the platinum and make contact with the islanders. Ukyo later discovers something on the seafloor and send Ginro to investigate.

episodes.name: The Trump Card Aboard the Science Vessel
episodes.overview: Amaryllis explains how she evaded petrification and how she came to her decision to sneak into the inner palace.

crew.name: Thanasit Chaipanyawong
crew.original_name: ธนสิทธิ์ ชัยปัญญาวงศ์

episodes.name: Beautiful Science
episodes.overview: Suika and Ginro work together to rescue the mobile lab from the Perseus. Reunited with Senku and the others, the group works on items to help Kohaku with the selection process.

episodes.name: SCIENCE WARS
episodes.overview: Amaryllis, Ginro and Kohaku are chosen to join the inner palace. The science team will need a way to communicate with them in secret, and, eventually, a way for them with the science team.

episodes.name: With This Fist, a Miracle
episodes.overview: Kohaku has located the treasure left behind by Byakuya and the others, but it's encased in concrete. Senku has to devise a plan to quietly get at the contents inside, so as to not alert the guards.

episodes.name: The Kingdom of Science's Counterattack
episodes.overview: Kohaku is forced to destroy Ryusui's statue to prove that she isn't a spy.

episodes.name: The Medusa's True Face
episodes.overview: The team revives Kaseki to work on the drone. Meanwhile, Ginro is called to see the Master.

episodes.name: Deal Game, Test of Wit
episodes.overview: More of the Kingdom of Science is brought back from petrification, but they are discovered in the cave by Moz.

episodes.name: Battle in Three Dimensions
episodes.overview: Moz and the Kingdom of Science form a tenuous, temporary alliance against Ibara. How long it will last is a question they can't afford to concern themselves with just yet.

episodes.name: Total War
episodes.overview: The Kingdom of Science attacks and tries to execute their plan to steal the petrification device. Moz convinces Kirisame to use the device, but Ryusui's instincts tell him something is off about the situation.

episodes.name: JOKER
episodes.overview: The Kingdom of Science members launch an attack on the islanders aboard the Perseus, but Moz isn't far behind and Senku and the others are forced to retreat inside the vessel. Ibara has them cornered, but Senku unleashes his Joker card.

episodes.name: Flicker of Doom
episodes.overview: Yo and the Kingdom of Science capture the petrification device, but Ibara isn't going down without a fight.

episodes.name: LAST MAN STANDING
episodes.overview: Much to Ibara's shock and dismay, Senku devised a plan and managed to escape petrification. Now the two enter into a head-to-head battle for control of the Medusa device.

episodes.name: FIRST DREAM
episodes.overview: Senku stands victorious. He then works on reviving the others and fixing their communications device, but while they are talking with Ruri they encounter a strong interference with the signal.

episodes.name: Treasure Island
episodes.overview: To the moon! That's the plan, at least. Senku and the Kingdom of Science need to devise a means with which to go to the moon and deal with Why-Man. The first step is allying with the people of Treasure Island and enlisting their help with some new crafts.

episodes.name: BEYOND THE NEW WORLD
episodes.overview: With the petrification device in the Kingdom's hands, it's time to revive Tsukasa. But there's just one problem: the device is out of batteries.

seasons.name: New World
seasons.overview:
With the ambitious Ryuusui Nanami on board, Senkuu Ishigami and his team are almost ready to sail the seas and reach the other side of the world—where the bizarre green light that petrified humanity originated. Thanks to the revival of a skillful chef, enough food is being prepared for the entire crew, and the incredible reinvention of the GPS promises to ensure safety on the open sea.

Preparations for the upcoming journey progress swimmingly until Senkuu receives an eerie message from a mysterious source. More driven than ever, the scientist sets out to explore the new world and discover what it can offer for his scientific cause. Though the uncharted territories may hide unkind surprises, Senkuu, with a little help from science, is ready to take on any challenge.

episodes.name: RYUSUI VS. SENKU
episodes.overview: Senku and his companions finally set off for America in search of corn. However, a dispute arises between Ryusui and Senku shortly after they depart.

episodes.name: SCIENCE JOURNEY
episodes.overview: Maintaining morale will be critical on the long journey to the Americas. Knowing where on the ocean you are is pretty important, too. The crew of the Perseus discuss.

episodes.name: Light Trap in the Darkness
episodes.overview: The Perseus lands in the Americas. They first head to Northern California in search of yellow dent corn, but discover a lot more than that.

episodes.name: Dr. X
episodes.overview: The search party narrowly escaped enemy machine gun fire. Unfortunately, the respite was short-lived.

episodes.name: DOCTOR VS. DOCTOR
episodes.overview: Tensions rise as Dr. Xeno makes his introductions to the Perseus.

episodes.name: SCIENCE IS ELEGANT
episodes.overview: Stanley orders Luna to infiltrate the Perseus and identify Doctor Taiju. Things go sideways when it turns out to be a little too easy.

episodes.name: The Two Scientists
episodes.overview: Senku had gotten his start in rocket building through an email exchange with Doctor Xeno. Their approaches to science soon diverged.

episodes.name: LOCK ON
episodes.overview: NASA scientist Dr. Xeno attempts to pick off the leader of the Kingdom of Science.

episodes.name: Light of Science
episodes.overview: With Senku having been shot, the Kingdom of Science plots its retaliation against Dr. Xeno.

episodes.name: Dirty Roads
episodes.overview: With Senku still confined to the bed, Chrome's team begins work on the tunnel to Xeno's base.

episodes.name: Those Who Know the Rules; Those Who Make Them
episodes.overview: Ryusui and Senku take to the skies in a science versus science dogfight while Xeno's forces mount a ground counterattack.

episodes.name: Reunion
episodes.overview: Xeno's army attacks and when all seems lost, Chrome and his friends finish the tunnel and capture Xeno.

episodes.name: Watching the Same Moon
episodes.overview: The team head to the source of the petrification beam in South America as they flee from Stanley's ship.

episodes.name: EARTH RACE
episodes.overview: Senku and company must flee from Stanley's ship, but they have to make stops to refuel.

episodes.name: The Escape
episodes.overview: With Stanley's ship hot on their tail, can science help Senku and company escape?

episodes.name: Medusa Mechanism
episodes.overview: The team is going to need a weapon for when Stanley inevitably catches up to them.

episodes.name: Sickening Yet Beautiful
episodes.overview: Senku and his team have lost Stanley for now, but they aren't out of — or rather, in — the woods just yet.

episodes.name: Diamond Heart
episodes.overview: The team discovers a giant pile of petrification devices. They take them apart to see what makes them tick.

episodes.name: Stone Sanctuary
episodes.overview: The team begins making, digging for, and polishing diamonds to replace the burnt-out ones inside the devices.

episodes.name: What I Once Sought to Destroy
episodes.overview: Suika is in charge of making sure Senku's plan works, but her kindness becomes an obstacle.

episodes.name: Our Dr. Stone
episodes.overview: With the revival team captured, it's up to Luna and Chelsea to revive everyone when the time comes.

episodes.name: Until We Meet Again
episodes.overview: With the petrification beam approaching, who will get their hands on the revival fluid?

episodes.name: Scientist, All Alone
episodes.overview: Suika gathers the team's statues, sets up camp and gets to work doing science.

episodes.name: Whole New World
episodes.overview: With Senku back, it's only a matter of time before the rest of the Kingdom of Science is revived.

episodes.name: Future Engine
episodes.overview: Senku and Dr. Xeno team up to gather the materials needed to make a rocket engine.

episodes.name: Fire
episodes.overview: The crew arrives in Spain, where they collect fluorite, olive oil and some treats.

episodes.name: The Universe Is Written in the Language of Mathematics
episodes.overview: The New Perseus sets out to India to recruit mathematicians for the space program.

episodes.name: Dawn of the Computer
episodes.overview: The computer that the team is building is a series of toroidal tubes. Senku explains.

episodes.name: The Truth About the Rocket
episodes.overview: The team gets to work wiring up several megabits' worth of memory donuts for their computer.

episodes.name: Stone to Space
episodes.overview: The team will need a stupidly insane amount of electricity to turn their bauxite into an aluminum rocket body.

episodes.name: Unknown Known
episodes.overview: With the computer completed, the team will need a user interface: a TV.

episodes.name: Challengers of Science
episodes.overview: The Kingdom of Science's rocket launches are mired by a string of rapid unscheduled disassemblies.

episodes.name: Wanting Everything
episodes.overview: The team is too small to build a round-trip rocket. They'll need to enlist help from around the world.

episodes.name: Countdown
episodes.overview: Ryusui may need to defer to a better pilot for the moon mission.

episodes.name: Giant Step
episodes.overview: The rocket needs to be assembled in space. Not an easy feat in the 21st century, let alone in the stone world.

episodes.name: Why-Man
episodes.overview: The team sets foot on the moon to confront Why-Man.

episodes.name: Ushers of an Exhilarating Future
episodes.overview: Senku offers Why-Man more exhilaration than they can handle.

seasons.name: Science Future
seasons.overview:
Having resolved the crisis in the Petrification Kingdom, Senkuu and his companions gear up to deal directly with the mastermind behind the petrification phenomenon—who supposedly resides on the moon. The ambitious spaceship project, however, requires immense manpower and critical resources scattered across the world. Thus, the Kingdom of Science exploration team kick-starts its transcontinental journey on the ship Perseus to gather them all.

Equipped with modern technology and bolstered by the new, capable members in their ranks, the exploration team feels confident about setting sail to their first destination: America. They soon realize that the region now hosts adversaries controlling the resources they need, doing so with scientific technology which rivals and even exceeds their own. In a battle of science versus science, Senkuu and his team must outsmart their rivals if they are to have any chance of ensuring the continued survival and rejuvenation of humanity.
